egress.terms: Metered per slice: 'Each storage VPS slice adds 1TB SATA storage, 2GB memory, 2TB transfer'. A 2:1 ratio. Overage rate not published on the page.

limits_note: Slice count adds RAM and cores linearly, which is wasted spend for pure storage. 10 Gbps shared port. The traffic ratio is the binding constraint, not the price.
reliability_note: Long-established US host (Secaucus/LA). The $3/TB headline is genuine and linear — 10 slices is $30 for 10 TB, no discount, no cliff. Page served a 403 and was retrieved via the provider renderer.

evidence.proved: 'Starts at $3.00 per TB per month'; 1 Slice $3/mo (1TB SATA, 2TB transfer, 10Gbps shared); 10 Slices $30/mo (10TB SATA, 20TB transfer); 20 Slices listed
same page — 'Use storage-optimized cloud compute for backups, archives, and high-volume file hosting when capacity matters more than raw application I/O'

price_per_tb_month: $3.00/TB/mo flat at 1, 5, 10, 20 TB — genuinely linear, no tier discount. Caveat: 2 TB transfer per TB stored does not cover 30 TB/mo serving at 20 TB stored (40 TB included, so it does at 20 TB; it fails at 10 TB stored where only 20 TB is included).

extras.price_verbatim: $3.00/TB/mo flat at 1, 5, 10, 20 TB — genuinely linear, no tier discount. Caveat: 2 TB transfer per TB stored does not cover 30 TB/mo serving at 20 TB stored (40 TB included, so it does at 20 TB; it fails at 10 TB stored where only 20 TB is included).
